settingProviderDesc: Choose how speech is recognized, then fill in that service's config below.
webspeechLanguageDesc: Language used by the browser's built-in recognition.
stillTranscribing: Still recognizing the previous clip, please wait.
noEditor: No active document found to insert text into.
errNoCursor: Recognition succeeded, but no usable editor cursor was found. Click the target insertion point before recording.
errInsertFailed: Recognition succeeded, but inserting text failed
errMobileUnsupported: Transcription is not supported on this frontend. Use it on desktop or in a desktop browser.
errNoProvider: The selected recognition service was not found. Please reselect it in settings.
errWebSpeechUnsupported: This browser does not support Web Speech recognition. Please use another service.
settingTailMsDesc: Keep recording this long after you click stop, so the last word is not cut off. 400 is a good starting point.
settingPadMsDesc: Digital silence added to both ends of the audio. Recognition models tend to swallow words right at the boundaries; padding prevents that.
settingConfirmDesc: Review and edit the recognized text before inserting. Enter accepts, Shift+Enter adds a line, Esc discards. The dictation shortcut always opens the preview.
settingCueDesc: Short tone when recording starts and stops.
errNoMicrophone: No microphone available. The browser only allows microphone access over https:// or on localhost.
asrBaseUrlDesc: Base URL of any service exposing an /audio/transcriptions endpoint; the path is appended automatically. Works with hosted providers as well as a transcription server you run yourself.
asrApiKeyDesc: Sent as a Bearer token. Stored only in your local SiYuan data. Leave a placeholder if your service needs no key.
asrModelDesc: The model parameter sent with each request. Which names are valid depends on the service you configured above.
asrLanguageDesc: Auto-detect suits mixed-language dictation. Naming the language explicitly is more accurate on short clips and prevents the odd sentence coming back translated.
asrPromptDesc: Comma-separated terms, names or jargon that occur in your dictation. Improves spelling of technical words. Ignored by services that do not support it.
errAsrNoBaseUrl: Please set the API base URL of your transcription service in the plugin settings first.
errAsrBadBaseUrl: The API base URL must start with http:// or https://.
errAsrNoApiKey: Please set the api-key for your transcription service in the plugin settings first.
settingSourceDesc: Microphone records you. System audio records what is playing — the browser asks you to share a screen or tab and you must tick its audio box. Availability depends on browser and OS.
settingDeviceDesc: Which microphone to use. Device names only appear after you have granted microphone access once. A virtual audio device (BlackHole, Loopback, VB-Cable) shows up here too and is the reliable way to capture system audio on macOS.
errDisplayUnsupported: This browser cannot capture system audio. Use a virtual audio device and select it as the input device instead.
errDisplayNoAudio: The share contained no audio. Repeat it and tick the audio box in the browser's share dialog — on macOS this only works when sharing a browser tab.
overlayRecordMore: Dictate at the cursor in this draft
